_about: Production-scale aligned-spin BBH configuration. Analyses a 4x longer segment at 4x the sample rate of the built-in defaults, from a 20 Hz lower cutoff, over a prior wide enough for a stellar-mass BBH search. Start here and narrow, rather than starting from the defaults (which are sized for smoke tests) and widening.
_costs: These settings are a defensible starting point, not a benchmarked optimum: duration x sampling_rate sets the number of frequency bins and therefore the per-likelihood cost, and n_chains x loops sets how many of those evaluations you pay for. Both should be re-tuned against your own waveform, network and hardware.

data._note: 8 s from 20 Hz covers the inspiral of a Mc >= 10 Msun binary with margin. Nyquist is 2048 Hz, comfortably above the ringdown of the heaviest binary in the prior. f_ref = f_min so spins and phase are defined at the edge of the analysed band.

prior._note: Chirp mass and mass ratio span the stellar-mass BBH range; spins go to near-extremal. Distance is uniform in Euclidean volume, p(d) ~ d^2. Orientation and sky are isotropic: sine in inclination, cosine in declination, uniform in ra/psi/phase.

injection._note: The injected population sits strictly inside the prior in the intrinsic parameters and distance, so no truth rails against a prior edge; orientation and sky span the full isotropic support. For a PP-plot campaign use examples/configs/pp_campaign.json instead, where this section IS the prior.

seeds._note: Vary seeds.noise alone to repeat the same injections under a new noise realisation; vary seeds.injection alone to draw a new population.

kernel._note: Step sizes are starting points only: GlobalLocalConfig.adapt_step_size is on by default, so these are adapted during the training loops toward the target acceptance rate.

sampler._note: More chains and more production loops than the defaults. n_chains scales GPU memory linearly; lower it first if you run out.

ns._note: nlive=1000 with a 0.01 termination criterion is a real nested-sampling run rather than the default smoke test.

gpry._note: n_initial null leaves GPry on its own 3*n_dim, which is what the infinities classifier expects; raising max_total buys surrogate accuracy at a linear cost in true likelihood evaluations.
